content.comment_body: Hello everyone, could someone share advice on how to implement a retentive timer in [company_name] [product_name] programming? My goal is for the timer to pause when input 1 switches to 0 and then resume counting when input 1 is set back to 1.
Hello, Refer to section 3.10.10 for information about the Retentive on-delay timer. You can find the details in the following resource: [url]

Hi, It may be necessary to design your own timer for this task. One approach is to use an asynchronous pulse generator together with a counter. An example is attached for reference. Hopefully, this meets your requirements. Best regards, [user_name]
